document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Y ou enter and cautiously turn on a light to see a room in proper 
professorial confusion. Scattered about are books of myths and 
fables, and there are bundles of clippings from various foreign 
newspapers. For each hour you spend here, you can attempt 
one roll for one of the following skills. Each skill may be tried 
once daily.
For a successful Astronomy roll, go to 24.
For a successful Science (Cryptography) roll, go to 29.
For a successful Cthulhu Mythos roll, go to 121.
For a successful INT roll, go to 32.
For a successful Luck roll, go to 49. 
For a successful Spot Hidden roll, go to 72. 
Finished? You may try a Stealth roll to sneak out, no matter 
what the hour; if you fail, go to 51. If you succeed, go to any 
Arkham Location.
(24, 29, 32, 51, 52, 53, 67, 68, 72, 121, 124, 188, 208, 212, 282)
